dedupe_keys.name: chemical analysis interpretation of rural household water supplies

description: This Alberta information source describes interpretation of routine chemical analysis for rural household water supplies. Its abstract identifies about fifteen chemical parameters, including hardness, sodium, sulphates, nitrates and nitrites. The source concerns drinking-water quality and chemical measurement interpretation; the metadata does not provide actual sample results, numeric thresholds, calculation formulae or a specific simulation application. The package lists a revised April 2015 PDF, a 2015 EPUB representation and a superseded March 2012 PDF. Those editions and representations remain one information resource. Exact changes between editions and present water-quality requirements have not been established. Coverage is rural household water supplies in Alberta, without a sampled geographical extent. Full descriptive metadata and original package identifiers are available through the Canadian Urban Data Catalogue. It labels these sources Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and actual document access are not stated or tested. No document body was fetched. Related editions and component representations are retained together; the technical contents and fitness for a particular model remain unverified.
